_doc: The asset contract (docs/explorations/2026-11-23-flexible-building.md). Every piece: its class, its fixed size in u (1 u = 0.6 m; the grid cell G = 2 u), its pivot (always the base centre of its front line), its front (+n: the piece's outward normal, toward the lower side or the street), and how it may vary. An instance the compiler emits must name a piece here and fit it; a model made for a piece must match it (tools/kit/fit.py). A set piece with "paving": "edge" is a building the laid paving is laid up to, as an edge its rows follow, not under (tools/kit/tess_layout.py; its outline is its model's base, tools/kit/model_base.py).

edge.retain.straight.note: a retaining face with its coping; the face stretches to the drop, the coping never does

edge.parapet.straight.note: retaining face + coping + a balustrade section between two piers

sweep.parapet.note: a parapet section bent along a curve; any length in range

edge.steps.straight.note: a short drop (0.3 to 1 m) you can step over anywhere along it: treads of 0.15 m running out onto the lower side (the dais rings, a stoop)

arch.through.note: a level crossing water on arches, built to size by the renderer: from (x,y) to (x2,y2) along one face, depth to the other face along (nx,ny), n arches across the span, springing at low, the deck at h; the water (mat) runs on under it. No model: the renderer shapes it and dresses it in the painted stone (ashlar)

cliff.face.note: a sea cliff, found by the compiler along every open edge dropping 2 m or more into water: pts is the top's line (the water on its right), h the top and low the water. The renderer lays the cliff kit along it (kit-cliff.ts): runs and fissured runs stretched to fill each straight stretch, a corner piece at each outside corner, now and then a buttress, all scaled to the drop

pipe.run.note: a conduit pipe, from a scene's pipe object: pts its route resolved to [x u, y u, z m], ends (open, plug or tee), tees and saddles from the compiler. No model: the renderer draws it to size (kit-pipe.ts): a brass tube with rounded bends, riveted collars at ends, joints and every 2.5 u, a blue enamel band every 5 u, sandstone saddles under level runs. Dressing: it blocks no one

glyph.run.note: a glyph path, from a scene's glyph object: runes carved flush into the floor that carry a well's power. pts its route resolved to [x u, y u, z m] along the floor (draped over kerbs, climbing wall faces), nodes (pad, junction, bend), w, col, state (lit, dim, dark) and s0 from the compiler. No model: the renderer draws it to size (kit-glyph.ts): a carved groove with glowing runes, a pulse running out from its start, medallions at pads, bends and junctions. Dressing for walking: it blocks no one

fall.curtain.note: water pouring into lower water, found by the compiler wherever a water level meets a lower water level across an edge (a drop of 0.5 m or more): pts is the lip's line (the lower water on its right), h and low the two waters. No model: the renderer draws it to size (kit-fall.ts): a ribbon over the lip, foam and puffs at its foot

sweep.kerb.note: a kerb along a curve (a road a step below its pavement)

sweep.wall.note: a building's wall along a curve (the great hall's front)

joint.pier.note: between two parapet sections; turned to the bisector of the two

joint.newel.note: where a parapet run ends: at a flight's head or a building

joint.corner.note: a coping block where a retaining run turns; the two copings butt under it

connector.flight.note: a whole flight: treads and its two cheek walls with coping, sloping with the steps

head-flank.note: either side of the head, just beyond the cheek walls, on the top landing

foot-flank.note: either side of the foot, on the bottom landing

vignette.bench-planter.note: a bench between two planters, its back to the front's opposite side

setpiece.armillary.note: the courtyard's landmark: the armillary on its own round dais (two 0.5 m rings); one model

setpiece.bell-tower.note: the marker at the balcony road's west turn

setpiece.beacon.note: the marker at the balcony road's east turn

setpiece.pier-round.note: a free-standing round pier, set in matched pairs: gateways, gates, thresholds

setpiece.gate-tower.note: a square tower either side of a road's gate

setpiece.plaza-disc.note: the sunk plaza's radial paving, laid over its floor and ring of steps out to the rim: flagstone rings and a compass medallion at the end of each of the inlay's seven channels (setpiece.plaza-inlay; the painted stripes taken out by tools/kit/retouch_disc.py, p34)

setpiece.plaza-inlay.note: the sunk plaza's radial floor as real stone (pin p34): a slab set into the floor inside the ring of steps, 0.12 m proud within a low rim, the decal on its top; seven channels 0.1 m deep run out from under the dais to the medallions, filled with the magic field flowing outward, each tinted its element's colour (read from the painted stripes). Built by kit-inlay.ts

setpiece.library.note: the library on the middle terrace's west wing, its door toward the armillary (the whole-court paint-over)

setpiece.workshops.note: the workshops on the middle terrace's east wing, its door toward the armillary

setpiece.hall-half.note: one half of the great hall; two stand either side of the north road, facing the plaza

setpiece.great-hall.note: the great hall: two wings and a gatehouse whose archway carries the north road through it (pin p5)

setpiece.greenhouse.note: the infirmary's great greenhouse (plan H, 2026-11-26: grander, the well's main purpose); fit scales evenly, so it fills the 26 u length and stands about 11.7 u deep and 7.4 m tall

setpiece.stills.note: the infirmary's open-sided distillery shed, east of the well

setpiece.infirmary-tent.note: an open-sided field-hospital tent with four cots, full size (cots about 1.9 m); two stand either side of the road on the infirmary's top terrace

setpiece.heal-station.note: a tent's healing station (the user's pick, pc6-station c, leads snipped: docs/reference/infirmary-kit/devices3/dev3-station.png): a brass cup of green crystal on a sandstone pedestal, where the tent's glyph line ends; its lead to the bed emitters is a thin glyph path. A grey stand-in until modelled

setpiece.bed-emitter.note: a bed emitter behind a cot's pillow (pc6-emitter b, alone: devices3/dev3-emitter.png): a carved sandstone post with a gold halo ring, on the tent's lead. A grey stand-in until modelled

setpiece.infirmary-well.note: the infirmary's caged well, structure only (its vines are grown in the game and draw back as the well relights); stands on the well's dais; overgrowth: its vines (lab/overgrowth.ts), measured off its model (m; post angles in degrees, atan2(z, x))

setpiece.battery-stack.note: the battery's smokestack seen from the infirmary's road, the cue on the way out; smoke is an effect from its flue (lab/kit-smoke.ts; at: the flue's centre in m, measured off its model)

setpiece.purifier-drum.note: the sea-water purifier's settling drum, standing in the cove as the jetty's head

setpiece.purifier-tower.note: the purifier's pump tower on the beach against the cliff, its top level with the forecourt above (the glyph path arrives there)

setpiece.boiler-house.note: the battery's boiler house beside its smokestack on the infirmary's road out

setpiece.tree-oak.note: a broad oak for the woods (scattered); shade: the darker grass under it (m across)

setpiece.tree-pine.note: a tall conifer for the woods (scattered)

setpiece.tree-blossom.note: a violet-blossom tree, as in the concept (scattered)

setpiece.bush-gold.note: a yellow-green shrub, grown in code (lab/foliage.ts): every one differs by where it stands

setpiece.bush-pink.note: a shrub in pink bloom, grown in code

setpiece.bush-lilac.note: a shrub in lilac bloom, grown in code

setpiece.bush-white.note: a small shrub in white bloom, grown in code

setpiece.flowerbed.note: a stone trough 3 m long planted with flowers (pink, lilac, white, blue spikes), its back away from its front: stand it against a wall. Grown in code

setpiece.topiary.note: a clipped cypress cone in a square stone planter, grown in code

setpiece.tree-bloom.note: a small round-headed tree in pink blossom, grown in code

setpiece.bush-yellow.note: a shrub in yellow bloom (broom, forsythia: the concept's yellow masses), grown in code

setpiece.tree-birch.note: a birch: a pale stem and a high, loose crown (the infirmary's woods, from the paint-overs), grown in code; only its stem blocks

setpiece.tree-cherry.note: a larger tree in pink blossom (the paint-overs' cherries), grown in code; only its stem blocks

setpiece.tree-wisteria.note: a small tree hung with wisteria (lilac racemes), grown in code

setpiece.grass-long.note: a drift of long grass on a lawn, grown in code; low (walked through, blocks nobody)

setpiece.meadow-flowers.note: long grass with white and yellow flowers through it, grown in code; low (blocks nobody)

setpiece.lavender.note: a drift of lavender and lupins in grass, grown in code; low (blocks nobody)

setpiece.field-wheat.note: a worked field of wheat in rows (the infirmary's farmland), grown in code

setpiece.field-greens.note: a worked field of low greens in rows, grown in code

setpiece.field-beans.note: a worked field of beans in flower, in rows, grown in code

dress.urn.note: a gilded urn on a pier cap

dress.cap-lantern.note: a small gold lantern on a pier cap

dress.planter.note: a pot with a plant: 3 pots x 4 plants

dress.lamp.note: a street lamp: 2 posts x 2 lanterns

dress.banner.note: one cloth mesh with an emblem texture per element (textures/banner-<emblem>.png)

dress.bollard.note: a cast-iron mooring bollard with a gold band (quay sheet, 2026-11-25)

dress.mooring-post.note: a timber mooring post with a rope round it (quay sheet)

dress.mooring-ring.note: an iron mooring ring in a stone block (quay sheet)

dress.hook-lamp.note: a brass lantern on an iron hook post (quay sheet)

dress.planter-bowl.note: an empty round stone planter bowl with a starred blue band, soil only (bath sheet, the infirmary 2026-11-26)

dress.planter-box.note: an empty square stone planter box with blind arches (bath sheet)

dress.planter-trough.note: an empty long stone planter trough with blind arches (bath sheet)

dress.urn-tall.note: a lidded two-handled urn on a fluted pedestal (bath sheet)

dress.urn-lidded.note: a shorter lidded two-handled urn on its own foot (bath sheet)

dress.towel-stand.note: a wooden towel stand with folded towels, a hanging towel and a brass jug on top (bath sheet)

dress.tent-poles.note: a bundle of gilt-tipped tent poles strapped together, lying on the ground, 2.5 m long (camp sheet, the infirmary 2026-11-27)

dress.tent-canvas.note: a roll of tent canvas tied with rope, its star-trimmed edge hanging loose (camp sheet)

dress.tent-stakes.note: a sack of wooden tent stakes with a mallet leaning on it (camp sheet)

dress.stretcher.note: a canvas stretcher on its folding legs, laid flat, 2 m long (camp sheet)

dress.blankets.note: a stack of folded blankets with blue stripes (camp sheet)

dress.medical-crate.note: an open gilt-cornered crate of bandage rolls and medicine bottles, knee high (camp sheet)

dress.bench.note: a stone bench facing a view

vine.ivy.note: a hanging leafy vine, grown in code (lab/foliage.ts) as wide as its wall section; without "grow" it is the painted strip, 1 x 3 m, cut to length

vine.violet.note: a hanging vine in pink and lilac bloom, grown in code

vine.grow-ivy.note: a long vine down a tall wall, grown in code to its longest path's length

vine.grow-violet.note: a long vine in bloom down a tall wall, grown in code

infirmary-garden.note: the infirmary's overgrown dressing (2026-11-27): vines spilling over its parapets and down its cliffs and walls, nothing formal

courtyard-formal.note: the courtyard's formal dressing, from the paint-overs

_doc_dress: Dressing (docs/explorations/2026-11-24-dressing-variation.md): pieces of class 'dress' are placed by a scene's 'dress' objects following a style in 'styles'. A rule puts pieces on sockets ('on' a joint piece, spread so none is within 'gap' u of another), at places ('at' flight-head / flight-foot, a pair) or 'along' road kerbs at a spacing. 'parts' pieces pick one of each part per instance; 'vary' gives a seeded scale and tint per instance (scatters use it too).
